## What We Do
Design. Develop. Deploy. We design, develop and market digital products built to make money.

## Services
Our standard offer is a bundle:
- High-Performance Website
- Local Booking Chatbot: Answers customer questions directly from the business website data alone, with zero external AI and zero API costs.
- Order or Enquiry Form: Direct routing to WhatsApp and email.
- Found on Google: Structured technical schema and search indexing.

Architectural add-ons:
- Full Automation: Automated customer workflows and notifications.
- Payment Gateway: Stripe and Razorpay integrations.
- Customer Desk: Ticketing and support workflows.
